schemaNote: The compile-shaped source uses exactly the prior11-row entry schema. Original English definitions and usage boundaries live in this separately reviewed companion; no unsupported compiler field or application schema change is made.

entries.definitionEn: To ask officially for a job, place, permission, funding or another thing you hope to obtain.
entries.grammaticalLabel: Verb phrase: a verb followed by the preposition for, not a noun or an interchangeable family of apply constructions.

requiredObject.role: The job, place, document, permission, support or other thing being requested.
requiredObject.ellipsisNote: The two-word dictionary head labels a productive pattern. Supply its object when using the complete pattern in a sentence, unless the context independently licenses leaving it understood.

entries.scopeZh: 本条只收正式申请某事物这一用法；提出申请不等于申请已经获准。

contrasts.pattern: apply to + receiving person or institution
contrasts.noteEn: The recipient of the application follows to; the thing requested follows for. A complete application can specify both roles.
contrasts.noteZh: 向某机构提出申请通常用 apply to；申请得到某个职位、入学名额或许可等则用 apply for。两种介词说明不同角色，可以在同一句中并用。

contrasts.pattern: apply to a university versus apply for a place or admission
contrasts.noteEn: Do not replace an institution after to with the same institution after for. A university can receive an application; a place or admission can be requested.
contrasts.noteZh: 不能把“申请大学”无条件关联到 apply for，更不能教成只要把大学名称直接放在 for 后面即可。

entries.aliasPolicy: Only the two complete Chinese pattern labels listed in source.json are proposed. Do not follow a synonym/word-family hop or manufacture institution aliases.
entries.originalExampleIntent: A hypothetical funding application; no statement that it will be approved.

entries.definitionEn: To finish the required studies successfully at a school, college or university.
entries.grammaticalLabel: Verb phrase: educational graduate followed by from plus its institution, not the noun graduate.

requiredObject.role: The school, college, university or other educational institution at which the person completed the studies.
requiredObject.ellipsisNote: The stored two-word head names a pattern; from needs its educational-institution complement when that full pattern is used.

entries.scopeZh: 本条收从教育机构毕业的常见用法；美式英语也常用于中学毕业，不把它限定为大学学位。也不据此保证毕业者获得何种具体学位。

contrasts.noteEn: The noun identifies a person who has completed education. That separate POS is not an inflected form of this verb phrase; noun patterns such as graduate of are outside this draft.
contrasts.noteZh: graduate 作名词时指毕业生；“毕业生”不作为本动词短语的中文别名，graduate of 这一名词结构也不作为其英文词形。

contrasts.noteEn: A field of study or qualification belongs to a different complement pattern. The institution role after from is not replaced by a subject or degree label.
contrasts.noteZh: 专业和所获资格使用其他结构；不要把 from 后的毕业学校与专业或学位混为一谈。

contrasts.noteEn: Figurative progression to another activity or level is outside the selected educational sense.
contrasts.noteZh: 由某阶段发展到另一阶段等比喻义未在本条核准。

entries.aliasPolicy: Only the whole Chinese educational pattern labels and the three explicit whole English inflections in source.json are proposed; no noun or transitive word-family expansion.
entries.originalExampleIntent: A hypothetical design-school graduate and later workshop; no claim about a real person or specific qualification.
